title: 第3687章 和万族为敌第一教皇的反对第3686章 区区鬼族而已真的来了
slug: 开局废了我开启最强进化
content_zh:
即便知道白娅在人族，妖族和鬼族也不敢彻底闹翻，顶多是在背地里用上一些见不得光的手段。
可现在，事情已经发生，就没办法敷衍过去。
“知道了，先下去吧，此事由本主召集其他巅峰主宰共同商议。”
“是！”
那名人族主宰恭敬退下后，卡洛斯便立即联系了其他巅峰主宰。
不多时，巅峰主宰们通过虚拟宇宙再次聚集，差不多有近二十位。
一见到卡洛斯，其中一位巅峰主宰便立马问道。
“卡洛斯，不是才刚开完会吗？怎么突然又把我们召集起来，难不成是空有什么指示？”
在场的巅峰主宰们都非常重视空这位人族最强者，真要是空的指示，他们必然慎重对待。
卡洛斯神色凝重的摇头道。
“不，此番将你们召集起来并非是因为空有什么指示，而是发生了另外一件事情。”
“哦？到底是什么事情？需要将我们这些巅峰组织全部召集起来？”
人族巅峰主宰虽然意见不同，但他们都是为了人族未来，并没有多少私心。
哪怕互相之间关系并不好，但在重要的事情上也会认认真真商议，而不是互相挤兑。
若非如此，人族也不可能在没有宇宙至尊的情况下，成为让妖族鬼族都忌惮的强大族群。
而这也多亏了空，白虎圣地人族能有这般规模和威慑力，离不开他以往的努力。
卡洛斯没有丝毫隐瞒，立即将刚才收到的消息告诉在场众人。
“诸位，刚刚收到消息，白虎圣地通道外例行巡视的鬼族小队全员覆灭，这件事情，很可能就是叶凌和白娅做的。
他们此刻，恐怕已经到了白虎圣地外，想来这会儿正在前往白虎圣地的通道内。
不单单是我们收到消息，巡视小队陨落，万族应该都已经收到消息。

只是万族现在不一定知道，巡视的鬼族小队是叶凌他们灭的。”
当卡洛斯将这个消息透露出来时，在场的巅峰主宰们，脸色变得无比严肃。
现场气氛凝重，他们都清楚，这件事情一点也不小。
难怪卡洛斯会突然将他们全部召集起来，原来是发生了如此严重的事情。
一位满头白发、面容苍老的巅峰主宰拧着眉头。
“卡洛斯，那个叶凌到底在想些什么？竟然直接对巡视通道的鬼族小队痛下杀手，他是疯了吗？
这么做无疑是在激怒鬼族，同时也是告诉万族他们来了。
鬼族必然已经知晓此事和他们有关，我们就算想帮他们，都不好直接出手。”
他这话的意思很明显，让卡洛斯或是其他巅峰主宰不要提什么给叶凌他们提供帮助的事情。
现在这种情况下，人族若是直接向叶凌他们提供帮助，那就是和万族走向对立面。
巡视白虎圣地外围的小队，怎么能被随意杀害？
哪怕对方来自鬼族，叶凌也不该直接动手灭杀。
content_en:
Even if they knew that Bai Ya was in the human race, the demon race and the ghost race would not dare to completely fall out. At most, they would use some shady methods behind their backs.
But now that things have happened, there is no way to deal with it.
"I know, let's go down first. This matter will be discussed by this master together with other peak masters."
"Yes!"
After the human master respectfully retired, Carlos immediately contacted other peak masters.
Not long after, the peak masters gathered again through the virtual universe, almost twenty of them.
As soon as he saw Carlos, one of the top masters immediately asked.
"Carlos, didn't you just finish the meeting? Why did you suddenly summon us again? Could it be that there was some instruction from Kong?"
The peak masters present all attach great importance to Kong, the strongest person in the human race. If it is Kong's instruction, they will definitely treat it with caution.
Carlos shook his head solemnly.
"No, I summoned you this time not because of any instructions, but because something else happened."
"Oh? What exactly is going on? Do we need to summon all of our top organizations?"
Although the peak masters of the human race have different opinions, they are all for the future of the human race and do not have much selfishness.
Even if they don't have a good relationship with each other, they will seriously discuss important matters instead of running against each other.
If not, it would be impossible for the human race to become a powerful race that even the demons and ghosts fear without the Supreme Being of the Universe.
And this is also thanks to Kong. The White Tiger Holy Land human race can have such a scale and deterrence, which is inseparable from his past efforts.
Carlos did not hide anything and immediately told everyone present the news he had just received.
"Everyone, I have just received news that the ghost team that was patrolling outside the passage of White Tiger Holy Land were all wiped out. This matter was probably done by Ye Ling and Bai Ya.
At this moment, they may have arrived outside the White Tiger Holy Land, and they think they are currently in the passage to the White Tiger Holy Land.
Not only we have received the news that the patrol team has fallen, but all races should have received the news.
But Wanzu may not know now that the patrolling ghost team was killed by Ye Ling and others. "
When Carlos revealed the news, the faces of the top masters present became extremely serious.
The atmosphere at the scene was solemn, and they all knew that this matter was not trivial at all.
No wonder Carlos suddenly called them all together, it turned out that something so serious had happened.
A peak master with white hair and an old face frowned.
"Carlos, what was Ye Ling thinking? He actually killed the ghost team patrolling the passage. Is he crazy?
Doing this will undoubtedly anger the ghost tribe, and at the same time, it will also tell all tribes that they are coming.
The ghosts must already know that this matter is related to them. Even if we want to help them, we can't do it directly. "
The meaning of his words was obvious, telling Carlos or other peak masters not to mention anything about providing help to Ye Ling and the others.
Under the current situation, if the human race directly provides help to Ye Ling and the others, it will be on the opposite side of the Wan race.
How could the team patrolling the outskirts of the White Tiger Holy Land be killed at will?
Even if the opponent is from the ghost clan, Ye Ling should not kill him directly.
